target.title: chore(ios): add deterministic streaming replay test harness for the shared chat pipeline
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The shared chat pipeline (`OpenClawChatViewModel` + `OpenClawChatTransport`) reconciles streaming deltas, provisional final messages, durable `session.message` rows, pendingRuns tracking, and post-send refresh — but there was no deterministic replay harness proving transcript convergence under duplicate, out-of-order, and reconnect delivery. Regressions in this reconciliation logic previously only surfaced as flaky live behavior.

Part of #100196

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a scripted-transport replay harness (`ChatStreamReplayTests.swift` in the OpenClawKit test target) that feeds a scripted event sequence through one FIFO stream so relative ordering is exact, and awaits observable view-model convergence points instead of fixed sleeps. Test-only; no production code changed and no injection seam was required.

## User Impact

None at runtime. Guards streaming/reconciliation behavior users see in the chat transcript: no duplicate rows, no lost content when provisional finals are replaced by durable rows, pending-run state draining on completion and reconnect, and byte-exact markdown streaming.

## Evidence

- `cd apps/shared/OpenClawKit && swift test --filter ChatStreamReplayTests` — 6/6 passed (0.115s, no simulator)
- `swift test --filter ChatViewModelTests` — 105/105 passed (existing suite unaffected)
- Scenarios: clean streaming run lossless convergence; duplicate durable delivery (keyed + unkeyed) single-row; provisional final → durable adoption preserving row identity; durable-before-completion no duplicate on late final; reconnect mid-run via foreground history refetch drains pendingRuns; markdown-shapes fixture streamed in 5-char cumulative chunks asserted byte-identical (UTF-8) at completion and post-adoption.
- Codex autoreview: clean, no accepted findings.

Note for reviewers: while building scenario (e), we noticed the `.seqGap` transport signal drains pendingRuns but does not clear `streamingAssistantText`; tracked separately as part of the reconnect work in #100197.
